description: Cassandra stores data across machines and groups rows by a partition key. You design a table around the question you need to ask. Learn a small reading log with CQL and see why its rules differ from ordinary table joins. Use a local single-node Cassandra 4+ practice cluster and cqlsh. The SimpleStrategy keyspace below is only for that local lesson. These commands do not run in this site's SQLite playground.
versionNote: Uses Cassandra 4+ CQL core features with a clearly limited single-node practice setup.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to state the question this table can answer efficiently
Learn to change the start date and predict which sample days match
Learn to explain why the delete names both key fields
learningObjectives: Learn to state the question this table can answer efficiently
Learn to change the start date and predict which sample days match
Learn to explain why the delete names both key fields
